next_question.rationale: We still have a large unexplained created->confirmed loss: top_gap shows lost = 417,569 while reason clusters sum to user_total = 199,417 + artifact_total = 42,107 = 241,524, leaving 176,045 unexplained. Large explicit user reasons include "user abandon the cart" = 111,993 and "user clicked back" = 83,517. Consultation-required items convert worse (rx_gated entered = 255,293, converted = 76,641, rate = 0.3002 vs non_rx entered = 391,898, converted = 152,981, rate = 0.3904) but pd_category counts for consultation-like categories are small (e.g., Digital Clinic entered = 3,889; Mental Health entered = 1,075) relative to the full loss. We have only a distribution-only view by price_band (75k_200k entered = 90,851; gte_200k entered = 66,220; 25k_75k entered = 62,875; lt_25k entered = 24,769) which does not allocate the unexplained 176,045 nor the big user reasons across bands. Requesting the created->confirmed funnel (entered, confirmed, conversion rate) plus abandon_reason counts broken down by price_band will: (a) allocate portions of the unexplained 176,045 loss across price bands, (b) show whether high-price orders have disproportionately low created->confirmed conversion or concentrate user reasons like "user abandon the cart" = 111,993 and "user clicked back" = 83,517, and (c) let us prioritize experiments (e.g., targeted payment options, discounts, platform messaging) for bands with high unexplained loss.
